column1: # tools/read-trace-map.tsv — dir #387 tier 3: surface -> required-doc map, DATA ONLY.
# This is deliberately NOT enforced. The PreToolUse deny-hook that would consume this file (block a
# session from touching a listed surface until its required doc shows up in the read-trace log) is
# NOT built — ships only when a specific surface has a FELT recurrence, recorded as an operator
# decision, same restraint tools/pre-pr-gate.sh's own tier-3-equivalent gates all earned through a
# real bite first. Every hard gate in this repo has a documented bite history; this map has none yet.
# Format: TAB-separated, 3 columns, comments start with '#'.
#   surface
# `surface` is one of three shapes: a bare path (a script/command file); a `ticket:<STATUS>`
# pseudo-surface (a ticket carrying that heading tag); or a `path:label` pair (a specific step inside a
# file, e.g. a command's own subagent step) — a cell containing `:` is one of the latter two shapes and
# is exempted from path resolution. `required_doc` is a repo-relative path to the doc that surface's own
# contract depends on, or the literal token BACKLOG.md for "read the ticket's own body" — never a path
# that does not resolve (tests/test_read_trace.sh's own binding test checks every row against this
# repo's live tree, the tools/self/doctor.sh dir #129 dead-reference discipline applied to this file).
